items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: And one of the men that played with him before the formation of Pierron's band was Louis Warnicke. I have a picture of Louis with McCollum's.

ctx.x: And how late did that last? I lost track.

I lost track. The minute I started getting a little bit older, the intense interest, when the minute I started going to Tulane, I began to have to study a little bit, and then the music began falling in the background, although we did play once in a while. Now then we began getting our music, as I say through the regular bands. And Oliver, comparatively late, because he began playing up at the gym. I remember I was going up to those gym dances on Saturday night before I was even in Tulane. A dollar a couple. Oh…
